thread:
Alex: quick follow-up from the postmortem call. Need to assign owners and deadlines for an alert-tuning sweep focused on noise, sensible thresholds, dedupe windows, and paging rules. Short bullets please.

Nina: I'll take payment-gateway alerts (gate-*). Plan: increase the error-rate threshold from 0.5% -> 1.0% for transient spikes and add a 3m burst suppression. Target: 2026-03-31.

Ravi: I'll audit dedupe settings across infra-service group. Proposal: default dedupe 8m for flapping metrics, but add a sliding-window check that escalates if occurrences >4 in 2h.

Priya: I'll patch the incident runbook and add a "suppression review" checklist so we don't hide regressions. Will also add a note to page for business-impacting alerts even if suppressed.

Alex: good. Can someone run a lightweight smoke harness before rollout? e.g., replay 2x normal error bursts and ensure paging still triggers for real incidents.

Nina: I'll spin up a canary and post results. Command I'll use:

```
# generate synthetic spikes against staging
seq 1 150 | xargs -n1 -P20 curl -sS -XGET https://staging.payments/health || echo spike
```

oncall-bot: created task INFR-2489 "Alert sweep: payment-gateway thresholds & suppression" assigned to Nina, due 2026-03-31.

Ravi: couple implementation notes: need to ensure dedupe change doesn't break downstream alert dedupe-metrics exporter. I'll run tests in staging Thurs AM.

Priya: timeline check: runbook PR by Thu, review Fri, rollout next week. Agree with paging rules: P0/P1 always page, P2 -> ticket by default.

Alex: owners/timelines summary: Nina (gateway thresholds + canary) due 2026-03-31; Ravi (dedupe audit + policy) will land staging tests Thu; Priya (runbook + paging policy) PR Thu. I'll follow up with PM and CS on customer-facing alert list. Add verification notes to the tasks when done.

Nina: will paste dashboard links and canary logs into INFR-2489.

Ravi: I'll also add a metric gating rule: if suppression hides >2 true positives in 24h, auto-revert suppression and alert SRE.

Alex: perfect. Let's keep changes minimal and observable. Thanks all. Tagging @incident-review for visibility. End of thread.
